headline: Jubilant Agri and Consumer Products advances its scheme of demerger
hook: Second motion petition filed for demerger
summary: Jubilant Agri and Consumer Products Limited has informed the stock exchange regarding the filing of the second motion petition for its scheme of arrangement for demerger. This is a procedural legal step in executing the corporate restructuring plan previously announced by the company. Shareholders and investors in the company are affected as the demerger progresses toward final court approval and subsequent share restructuring. Retail investors holding the stock need to track how the separated business units will be listed and valued.
whats_next: Final NCLT order on the demerger scheme
why_it_matters: Corporate restructuring alters shareholding structures and future business valuations.
